sample_unit: guidelines (LLM-derived guideline appraised with AGREE-S vs SAGES guideline)

links.outcome: LLM performance on guideline development tasks versus SAGES guideline (AGREE-S)
links.effect: LLMs could not independently perform systematic literature search or reliably perform screening, data extraction, or risk of bias assessment. AGREE-S total 119 for LLM-derived guideline vs 156 for SAGES.
links.quote: These LLMs were unable to independently perform a systematic literature search or reliably perform screening, data extraction, or risk of bias assessment at the time of testing.

screen.reason: Empirically evaluates the capability of multiple LLMs to generate clinical practice guideline components for appendicitis compared against an existing guideline using the AGREE-S instrument.
